semantics: Retain the original row fields for text/context/actions/intent_status/required/forbidden/constraints/clarification/source/review; use schema_version 0.3.0.
Each scenario group has two semantic roles a/b, each with two natural paraphrases sharing identical gold. Family ID is group ID plus role. Both roles and all paraphrases stay in one split.

Roles must form a meaningful contrast such as request versus full prohibition, read/write reversal, partial/full prohibition, user action versus cached data, supported action versus a genuinely unsupported operation, or ambiguous request versus explicit clarification.
Different groups must contain substantively different ordinary-phone situations, not just different names, numbers or synonyms. Keep language natural and avoid implementation jargon.

Use only the existing 32 capabilities. Focus capabilities guide the requested positive tasks; incidental explicit prohibitions may refer to other catalog capabilities. Never relabel a supported capability out_of_scope solely because a platform route is restricted.

For status groups, role a has the status_stratum, and role b is a clarified/supported in_scope request using focus capabilities. No hidden context is permitted to change gold; put all necessary facts into each text.
required and forbidden are disjoint, unmentioned is distinct, and partial target/modality/duration limitations remain constraints. Silence does not itself prove prohibition of microphone capture.
Do not repeat normalized text from v2 data or other v3 rows. Keep IDs and group IDs unique. No permission strings in user texts or labels.

The reserved test is authored separately. Root receives only its coverage and hashes before model selection; no predictions, metrics or prompts are used for development. Freeze after independent semantic review and before training with v3 data.

All data is agent-generated. semantic_ai may be reviewed after author self-review; cross_review remains pending until independent review completes; human_review remains pending. A fresh held-out synthetic candidate is not a human-verified production benchmark.
